Each equilateral triangle has side length 21/3 = 7 inches. The hexagon's side equals the triangle's side (the triangles meet at the center, and the outer side of each triangle is a hexagon side). So the hexagon's perimeter is 6 × 7 = 42 inches.

Solution A wrongly claims that each triangle's side is one-sixth of the hexagon's perimeter and then builds an inconsistent equation (P_t = P_h/6), which leads to 126. Solution B is correct.

WINNER: B
